All done. Here's a summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (latest) was unhealthy in production, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy release. (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging, so it wasn't a candidate.)
2. **Rollback**: Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0**. The first attempt partially failed — us-east rolled back but an orchestrator error halted us-west and eu-west, leaving the service in a mixed state with an 18% error rate. A retry completed the rollout successfully; all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0.
3. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") documenting the rollback, the partial failure and retry, and noting that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures still needs investigation. The initial create request timed out, but I verified via the incident list that it was created exactly once (no duplicate).
